title: Map on a cochain short complex from a finite cosimplicial map
statement: For a preadditive category A, cosimplicial objects K,L, q≥0 and a natural transformation between their truncations through q+1, construct the induced map from the three-term short complex of K at q to that of L. Its components are the finite-map components in degrees prev(q),q,next(q).

source.place: Detailed proof paragraph 2: only cochain degrees through q+1 are needed; elementary alternating-coface naturality.

proof.text: Naturality at every coface commutes with the alternating sum defining each differential. For pairs of degrees not differing by one the differential is zero. The predecessor and successor of q in the natural-number cochain shape lie through q+1, including predecessor zero at q=0. These equations verify both short-complex squares for the three displayed components.

proof_origin.place: Detailed proof, paragraph 2: finite skeleton descent and finite-cochain section continuity; explicit categorical construction with Grothendieck coefficients.

mathlib_searches.query: Homology functor on short complexes preserves filtered colimits in a Grothendieck abelian category
The cohomology of a cosimplicial object in an abelian category depends only on its truncation through degree q plus one and maps of such truncations extend after hypercover refinement

from.place: Detailed proof, paragraph 2: finite skeleton descent and section representatives
